My work combines mechanistic reasoning, quantitative analysis, and
computational implementation. Projects are organized by their primary
scientific application and tagged by the methods used.

## Quantitative Systems Pharmacology

Projects using mechanistic models and virtual populations to connect
drug mechanisms, biological heterogeneity, and treatment response.

::: {.project-card}

### Oncology drug development

My current postdoctoral research applies quantitative systems pharmacology
to questions in oncology drug development. This work integrates therapeutic
mechanisms, tumor biology, immune response, and biological heterogeneity
within mechanistic computational models.

My contributions include model development, virtual-population generation,
in silico clinical-trial simulation, treatment-response analysis, and
investigation of potential biomarkers.

Because this work is part of an ongoing academic–industry collaboration,
project-specific models, compounds, results, and implementation details are
not presented publicly at this stage.

[Learn more](projects/qsp.qmd){.btn .btn-primary}

## Pharmacometrics and PK/PD

Population pharmacokinetic, PK/PD, exposure, covariate, simulation,
and uncertainty-quantification projects.

::: {.project-card}

### Population pharmacokinetics of warfarin

An educational population PK case study exploring structural-model selection,
covariate modeling, allometric scaling, model diagnostics, and bootstrap
uncertainty analysis using public warfarin data.

[Explore project](projects/warfarin-population-pk.qmd){.btn .btn-primary}
[Access original data](https://monolixsuite.slp-software.com/monolix/2024R1/warfarin-data-set){.btn .btn-outline-primary}

## Mechanistic Systems Biology

Published mechanistic models of endothelial-cell signaling, hypoxia,
angiogenesis, and vascular function.

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-lg-4}
::: {.project-card}

### HIF signaling in endothelial cells

A validated mechanistic model resolving oxygen sensitivity, the
HIF1-to-HIF2 temporal switch, PHD-mediated feedback, and VEGFA regulation
under hypoxia.

[Explore project](projects/hif-signaling.qmd){.btn .btn-primary}
[Publication](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.isci.2026.116195){.btn .btn-outline-primary}

## Natural Products and Translational Modeling

Quantitative approaches for natural products, medicinal plants,
and complex biological interventions.

::: {.project-card}

### Medicinal plants as an emerging research direction

I am developing a research direction that connects medicinal plants and
natural products with quantitative pharmacology, systems biology, and
translational modeling.

Initial work focuses on organizing evidence linking medicinal plants,
bioactive compounds, molecular targets, biological pathways, and disease
contexts. The longer-term goal is to identify questions for which mechanistic
modeling can help integrate fragmented experimental evidence and prioritize
testable therapeutic hypotheses.

This area is presented as an emerging direction rather than as a completed
research program. Public case studies will be added as the underlying datasets,
research questions, and modeling workflows mature.
